about_the_game:
Hidden in the sakura branches, the ancient temple holds many secrets. The summer festival is in full swing, and even the Yokai have come to visit. You will have to find all the hidden objects in this area, so that the black and white world will be painted in bright colors and come to life. You decide what items you want to find!

Enjoy the game with atmospheric music. Suitable for the whole family

Game features:

- 150 search items

- Option to choose the item you want to search for

- Increasing level of difficulty

- There is a hint

- Interactivity. Items can also be searched inside buildings

- The world is populated by inhabitants, each one has a story to tell

- Coloring levels

- 2.5D effect

- Possibility to meet Yokais
